description.p: Alatus is a lightweight, native Linux control center for modern ASUS Vivobook and Zenbook laptops. It allows you to tweak deep hardware settings that are usually only available on Windows.
This is a community package and is not officially supported by ASUS.

ul.li: Battery Care: Set charging limits to 80% to prolong battery lifespan.
Fan Profiles: Switch between Quiet, Balanced, Performance, and Full Speed modes.
OLED Care: Manage flicker-free dimming and pixel refresh conditioning.
Keyboard Backlight: Single-zone RGB and desktop accent color sync.

description.p: Alatus v1.0.0 Genesis Release: Definitive initial stable release of the native ASUS hardware orchestration suite in Rust, featuring ACPI WMI DebugFS thermal management, Full Speed fan profile, ITE5570 LampArray RGB, Flicker-Free OLED Care, single-instance D-Bus desktop integration, and Material 3 Slint interface.

Hotfix release: implement FreeDesktop D-Bus single-instance application guard to prevent duplicate tray icons and raise existing windows, hide duplicate launcher in application menus via NoDisplay desktop entry alignment, and install multi-resolution raster PNG window icons for KDE Plasma Wayland decorations.

Wayland and UI refinement: dynamically discover and inject Wayland environment variables for kscreen-doctor child processes with resilient D-Bus fallback via org.kde.Solid.PowerManagement, sanitize verbose GPU device specifications, and align System Specifications into a balanced symmetrical 2-column grid.

Architectural overhaul: fixed Wayland compositor dimming and kscreen-doctor integration, eliminated taskbar ghost window on minimized startup, implemented atomic configuration persistence, fixed Wayland titlebar icon association, and expanded System Specifications with a dedicated Battery Health telemetry breakdown.
Added universal FreeDesktop StatusNotifierItem system tray icon, minimize-to-tray window management, autostart toggle, and routed ASUS WMI DebugFS diagnostics through alatusd over D-Bus.
Redesigned Slint GUI Home view with minimalist layout, added dedicated System Info page, and introduced interactive Hardware Compatibility Test Suite.
